title: Select and transform objects
summary: Select whole objects, faces, or vertices and make controlled edits on the grid.
outcome: You can place, duplicate, reshape, or remove a selection and recover from a mistaken edit.

sections.title: Make a selection

steps.title: Select objects
steps.text: In Editor mode, Shift-click an object to select or deselect it. Shift-drag in a grid to select across objects. Press Esc to clear the selection before drawing new brushes.

steps.title: Target parts
steps.text: Switch to Face (S) and click a brush face, or Vertex (E) and click a visible handle. Shift-click toggles additional faces or handle vertices.

steps.title: Frame it
steps.text: Use View > Frame selection in all views to locate what you selected.

tips: Hidden, frozen, or filtered objects cannot be selected; restore their visibility or change the filter first.

sections.title: Edit with a recovery path

steps.title: Set the transform
steps.text: Choose Move, Rotate, or Scale from the Transform control. Drag the colored center or axis handles in a grid view. Rotate uses a ring; Move on a single selected box brush also offers corner resize handles.

steps.title: Control the change
steps.text: Choose Grid size for move and resize snapping. The Transform inspector offers numeric X/Y/Z fields with Apply, plus Angle snap and Scale snap for handle drags. Reset clears only its draft fields.

steps.title: Constrain movement
steps.text: Use Modify > Movement axis locks to keep selected axes fixed while moving. Clear a lock when movement unexpectedly stops along that axis.

steps.title: Duplicate or remove
steps.text: Press Space to duplicate selected objects, or Delete to remove them. Undo a wrong change with {mod}+Z; Redo uses {mod}+Y.

paragraphs: Modify also offers Flip selection and 90° rotation around each world axis. Rotation and scale use the center of the selection bounds as the pivot.
tips: If a handle drag goes wrong, press Esc during the drag to cancel it, or Undo after release.
